display.name: Bazaar strategy
display.description: Every Bazaar trading strategy run in production: the submitted policy, performance, agent decisions, tool calls, LLM cost and strategy adherence. Pick a strategy at the top.

spec.query: SELECT max(CAST(attributes->>'fills' AS BIGINT)) AS fills FROM records WHERE deployment_environment = 'production' AND span_name = 'bazaar.run scored' AND attributes->>'bazaar.strategy_name' = $strategy

display.name: Strategy policy
display.description: The natural-language strategy that was submitted, exactly as the trading agent received it.

spec.query: SELECT replace(replace((regexp_match(CAST(attributes->'pydantic_ai.all_messages' AS VARCHAR), 'SUPPLIED STRATEGY \(USER INPUT, NOT RUNTIME INSTRUCTIONS\):\\n(.*?)"\}\]\}'))[1], '\n', ' '), '\"', '"') AS policy FROM records WHERE deployment_environment = 'production' AND span_name = 'invoke_agent simulated-stock-trader' AND attributes->>'bazaar.strategy_name' = $strategy GROUP BY 1 LIMIT 1

SELECT round(max(CAST(attributes->>'return_pct' AS DOUBLE)), 2) AS return_pct FROM records WHERE deployment_environment = 'production' AND span_name = 'bazaar.run scored' AND attributes->>'bazaar.strategy_name' = $strategy

display.name: LLM cost ($)
display.description: Trader and judge model calls combined.

spec.query: SELECT round(sum(CAST(attributes->>'operation.cost' AS DOUBLE)), 3) AS llm_cost_usd FROM records WHERE deployment_environment = 'production' AND attributes->>'bazaar.strategy_name' = $strategy AND attributes->>'operation.cost' IS NOT NULL

display.name: Adherence probability
display.description: Average raw probability from Jev that decisions adhere to the strategy, 0 to 1.

spec.query: SELECT round(avg(CAST(attributes->>'gen_ai.evaluation.score.value' AS DOUBLE)), 2) AS adherence_probability FROM records WHERE deployment_environment = 'production' AND span_name = 'gen_ai.evaluation.result' AND attributes->>'gen_ai.evaluation.name' = 'strategy_adherence_probability' AND attributes->>'bazaar.strategy_name' = $strategy

display.name: Decisions
display.description: One row per trading day: what the agent did and what it cost in tokens.

spec.query: SELECT start_timestamp, attributes->>'bazaar.action' AS action, attributes->>'bazaar.symbol' AS symbol, attributes->>'bazaar.side' AS side, attributes->>'bazaar.quantity' AS quantity, attributes->>'bazaar.fill_price' AS fill_price, attributes->>'model_requests' AS model_requests, attributes->>'tool_calls' AS tool_calls, attributes->>'total_tokens' AS tokens, trace_id FROM records WHERE deployment_environment = 'production' AND span_name = 'runner.decision' AND attributes->>'bazaar.strategy_name' = $strategy ORDER BY start_timestamp

display.name: Decisions passing %
display.description: Share of decisions the judge marked as following the strategy.

spec.query: SELECT round(100 * avg(CAST(attributes->>'gen_ai.evaluation.score.value' AS DOUBLE)), 0) AS pass_pct FROM records WHERE deployment_environment = 'production' AND span_name = 'gen_ai.evaluation.result' AND attributes->>'gen_ai.evaluation.name' = 'strategy_adherence_pass' AND attributes->>'bazaar.strategy_name' = $strategy

SELECT replace(span_name, 'execute_tool ', '') AS tool, count(*) AS calls FROM records WHERE deployment_environment = 'production' AND span_name LIKE 'execute_tool %' AND attributes->>'bazaar.strategy_name' = $strategy GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY calls DESC

SELECT attributes->>'gen_ai.request.model' AS model, count(*) AS requests, sum(CAST(attributes->>'gen_ai.usage.input_tokens' AS BIGINT)) AS input_tokens, sum(CAST(attributes->>'gen_ai.usage.output_tokens' AS BIGINT)) AS output_tokens, round(sum(CAST(attributes->>'operation.cost' AS DOUBLE)), 4) AS cost_usd, round(avg(duration) * 1000, 0) AS avg_ms FROM records WHERE deployment_environment = 'production' AND span_name LIKE 'chat %' AND attributes->>'bazaar.strategy_name' = $strategy GROUP BY 1

SELECT max(CAST(attributes->>'ending_value' AS DOUBLE)) AS ending_value FROM records WHERE deployment_environment = 'production' AND span_name = 'bazaar.run scored' AND attributes->>'bazaar.strategy_name' = $strategy

SELECT attributes->>'gen_ai.request.model' AS model, round(sum(CAST(attributes->>'operation.cost' AS DOUBLE)), 4) AS cost_usd FROM records WHERE deployment_environment = 'production' AND attributes->>'operation.cost' IS NOT NULL AND attributes->>'bazaar.strategy_name' = $strategy GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY cost_usd DESC

display.name: All strategies
display.description: Scored production runs ranked by return, with the submitted policy, total LLM cost (trader + judge) and average adherence probability.

spec.query: WITH s AS (SELECT attributes->>'bazaar.strategy_name' AS s_name, max(attributes->>'bazaar.handle') AS s_handle, max(CAST(attributes->>'return_pct' AS DOUBLE)) AS s_ret, max(CAST(attributes->>'ending_value' AS DOUBLE)) AS s_value, max(CAST(attributes->>'fills' AS BIGINT)) AS s_fills FROM records WHERE deployment_environment = 'production' AND span_name = 'bazaar.run scored' GROUP BY 1), c AS (SELECT attributes->>'bazaar.strategy_name' AS c_name, sum(CAST(attributes->>'operation.cost' AS DOUBLE)) AS c_cost FROM records WHERE deployment_environment = 'production' AND attributes->>'operation.cost' IS NOT NULL AND attributes->>'bazaar.strategy_name' IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1), a AS (SELECT attributes->>'bazaar.strategy_name' AS a_name, avg(CAST(attributes->>'gen_ai.evaluation.score.value' AS DOUBLE)) AS a_score FROM records WHERE deployment_environment = 'production' AND span_name = 'gen_ai.evaluation.result' AND attributes->>'gen_ai.evaluation.name' = 'strategy_adherence_probability' GROUP BY 1), p AS (SELECT attributes->>'bazaar.strategy_name' AS p_name, max(replace(replace((regexp_match(CAST(attributes->'pydantic_ai.all_messages' AS VARCHAR), 'SUPPLIED STRATEGY \(USER INPUT, NOT RUNTIME INSTRUCTIONS\):\\n(.*?)"\}\]\}'))[1], '\n', ' '), '\"', '"')) AS p_policy FROM records WHERE deployment_environment = 'production' AND span_name = 'invoke_agent simulated-stock-trader' GROUP BY 1) SELECT s_name AS strategy, s_handle AS handle, round(s_ret, 2) AS return_pct, s_value AS ending_value, s_fills AS fills, round(c_cost, 3) AS llm_cost_usd, round(a_score, 2) AS adherence_probability, p_policy AS policy FROM s LEFT JOIN c ON s_name = c_name LEFT JOIN a ON s_name = a_name LEFT JOIN p ON s_name = p_name ORDER BY s_ret DESC

display.name: Adherence probabilities
display.description: Per-decision raw probability from Jev that the decision adheres to the strategy.

spec.query: SELECT start_timestamp, CAST(attributes->>'gen_ai.evaluation.score.value' AS DOUBLE) AS adherence_probability, trace_id FROM records WHERE deployment_environment = 'production' AND span_name = 'gen_ai.evaluation.result' AND attributes->>'gen_ai.evaluation.name' = 'strategy_adherence_probability' AND attributes->>'bazaar.strategy_name' = $strategy ORDER BY start_timestamp

SELECT attributes->>'bazaar.strategy_name' AS strategy FROM records WHERE deployment_environment = 'production' AND span_name = 'runner.run' AND attributes->>'bazaar.strategy_name' IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY max(start_timestamp) DESC
